locator.section: 8.x Proton-bound complexes in CI: protonated phenyl 3-butenyl ether

evidence.curator_note: The book (eq 8.15) DRAWS a proton-bound complex [PhO...H...butadiene] as the intermediate from the methane-CI [M+H]+ ion of phenyl 3-butenyl ether; the non-covalent complex is NOT separately encoded (partial bonds not RDKit-representable) - this record encodes the net rH reaction precursor->protonated phenol (100%). 0 electron-pushing arcs drawn (only 'rH' reaction arrows). Equation 8.15, branch giving protonated phenol (labelled 100% on the page). Protonated phenyl 3-butenyl ether (C6H5-O+(H)-CH2CH2CH=CH2, the MH+ from exothermic methane CI) rearranges by rH ('rH' on the reaction arrow) to a proton-bound complex [phenol...H+...butadiene] (drawn explicitly on the page) which splits, here leaving the proton on phenol (PA 8.5 eV) -> protonated phenol PhOH2+ (m/z 95) + neutral 1,3-butadiene. INTERMEDIATE OMITTED: the drawn proton-bound complex is a non-covalent ion-neutral complex, not cleanly representable as a covalent SMILES, so this record encodes the NET rearrangement as one formal-arrow step. Book draws 0 electron-pushing arcs (reaction-level scheme with reaction arrows and a branch point); both encoded moves are reconstructed for electron balance (not drawn on the page): move <1> routes a C10-H20 sigma pair (a beta H of the butenyl chain) into the forming C9=C10 pi bond of butadiene, move <2> routes the O7-C9 sigma pair into the new O7-H20 bond that makes PhOH2+. A 1,4-hydrogen shift/1,2-elimination across the O-CH2-CH2 unit; closed-shell throughout. The migrating H is written as isotope-tagged [1H:20] so RDKit preserves its atom map; the original O-proton (H on O7) is implicit and non-migrating in this branch.

NO MOD rule is cross-linked: rule_index by_equation['8.15'] is null. In src/data_generation/rules/IMS_chap8_examples.py the comment 'Gl. 8.15' (line ~650) is present but no Rule.fromDFS follows it -- the equation was never encoded. rule_mismatches: none (nothing to compare against).

Book prints '100%' under the protonated-phenol product. observed_mz 95.0486 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of PhOH2+ (C6H7O+, electron-mass corrected); the page prints the relative abundance (100% -> relative_intensity 1.0) but no m/z.
